extDescription.message: Ask AI about the page you're reading: summaries, explanations and translations without leaving Safari.

emptyTitle.message: What would you like to know?

emptyPage.message: I can see this page. Ask a question or pick an action.

emptySelection.message: Ask about the selected text or pick an action.

emptyNone.message: This page can't be read, but you can ask me anything.

promptSummarize.message: Summarize this page in 5–7 bullet points, then give the main conclusion in one sentence.

promptKeyPoints.message: What are the key takeaways from this page? List the important facts, numbers and dates.

promptExplain.message: Explain this page in simple words, as if to a smart 12-year-old.

promptTranslate.message: Translate the main content of this page into {0}. Keep the structure and headings.

promptSelExplain.message: Explain the selected text in simple words.

promptSelImprove.message: Rewrite the selected text to be clearer and more concise. Give one improved version.

promptReply.message: Draft a short, polite reply to this message or post.

promptGoogle.message: Search Google for the latest information on the topic of this page and give me an overview.

promptSelGoogle.message: Search Google for the selected text: what is it, with the key facts.

chatsEmpty.message: No chats yet. Ask something to start one.

chatNameHint.message: Leave it empty to name the chat after its first question.

uxRemindOff.message: Notifications are off for ContextFlow. Turn them on in Settings → Notifications → ContextFlow.

uxRemindAsk.message: Open the ContextFlow app once and allow notifications, then set the reminder again.

uxRemindNone.message: Reminders need the ContextFlow app on this device.

uxRemindNotSet.message: Saved to the chat. For the reminder, allow ContextFlow's notifications.

uxRemindNoApp.message: Saved to the chat. Reminders need the ContextFlow app on this device.

uxShareMarksHint.message: Telegram, Notion and Slack show them in bold; Messages and Notes show the asterisks. Copy always keeps the bold.

errNetwork.message: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

errBusy.message: ContextFlow is very busy right now. Please try again in a minute.

errUpstream.message: The AI service didn't respond. Please try again.

errBadKey.message: Your API key was rejected. Check it in Settings.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errSearchLimit.message: You've reached the limit of Google answers for now. Regular answers still work.

errSearchUnavailable.message: Google answers aren't available right now. Regular answers still work.

usagePro.message: Pro · {0} of {1} answers left this week

consentBody.message: To answer, ContextFlow sends your question and the text of this page (or your selection; for AI search and “Ask your chats”, excerpts of your chats) via our server to Anthropic (Claude) or, if it's unavailable, OpenAI; Google answers go to Google. Page content and chats are not stored on our servers; your chats stay on your devices and, if you sync them, in your iCloud.

consentAgainTitle.message: Updated: answers now come from Claude

consentNeeded.message: Nothing was sent: AI answers need your consent first.

setFabHint.message: The ✦ button opens ContextFlow on any site. Hide it on a single site with the link below, or turn it off here.

setAboutHint.message: Optional. Helps tailor answers, e.g. “I'm a product designer, keep it short”.

setOwnKeyHint.message: Included in Pro and Own key plans. Paste an OpenAI or Anthropic (Claude) key; requests go straight from your device to that provider.

setOwnKeyLocked.message: Available with Pro or Own key plan

setOwnKeyModelHint.message: Fast: newest Claude Haiku or GPT mini. Smart: newest Claude Sonnet or GPT.

setSyncChatsHint.message: Continue a chat on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. The chat is end-to-end encrypted in your iCloud and never stored on our servers.

googleModeHint.message: Answer with Google Search: fresh facts with sources

tourAskBody.message: ContextFlow reads the page you're on; with Pro, also the videos with captions and the PDFs on it. Pick an action like Summarize, or type your own question.

tourSelectBody.message: Select text on the page first, and the answer is about just that. This label shows what ContextFlow reads.

tourGoogleBody.message: Turn this on to answer with Google Search: current information with sources.

tourChatsBody.message: A chat carries on from page to page. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.

tourChatsBodySync.message: A chat carries on from page to page, and on your iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud. Start a new one with +, and open, rename or delete earlier ones in the chat list. Tap a page's name in the chat to go back to it.

tourSettingsBody.message: Theme and text size, the ✦ button, a few words about you for better answers, your own API key and your plan. These tips are here too.

tourNoteBodyTouch.message: Swipe this button up or down to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.

tourNoteBodyMouse.message: Scroll on this button (or hold it) to write a note instead of asking. It stays in the chat with its page and uses no answers.

tourWholeBody.message: Turn on Whole chat when a question needs everything: all messages, your notes and the other pages of this chat. Off, answers use the last messages and this page.

welcomeBody.message: Open any website and tap the ✦ button or the ContextFlow icon in the toolbar. Select text to ask about just that part.

welcomeRestricted.message: Safari doesn't let extensions read this page. Open a regular website to use ContextFlow.

welcomePermission.message: If nothing happens, allow ContextFlow on all websites: Safari → Extensions → ContextFlow → All Websites → Allow.

selNoteTitle.message: Save the selection to the chat as a note (uses no answers)

selHint.message: New: type your own question about the selection here, or save it to the chat as a note — notes use no answers.

placeholderNote.message: Write a note — it stays in this chat

noteHintTouch.message: Swipe the button up or down to write a note

noteHintMouse.message: Scroll on the button to write a note

wholeChatHint.message: Answers take the whole chat into account: every message, your notes and the pages of this chat. Off: the last messages and the open page.

limitFreePro.message: Pro gives you up to {0} answers a week, videos and PDFs on the page, AI search and questions across all your chats.

limitNotes.message: Notes stay free and unlimited: write down what matters now, ask AI about it later.

offerLimit.message: Or get Pro with {0}% off your first month: up to {1} answers a week, deeper and more detailed. Cancel any time.

offerCardBody.message: You've hit the free daily limit before. Pro gives you up to {1} answers a week, deeper and more detailed, and your first month is {0}% off. Then the regular price; cancel any time in your App Store settings.

emptyVideo.message: I can see this video and will read its transcript. Ask a question or pick an action.

emptyPdf.message: I can see this PDF. Ask a question or pick an action.

videoNoTranscript.message: This video has no captions: the answer uses its title and description.

videoFailed.message: Couldn’t get this video’s transcript: the answer uses its title and description.

pdfNoText.message: “{0}” has no text to read (scanned pages): the answer is without it.

pdfFailed.message: Couldn’t read the PDF “{0}”: the answer is without it.

askHistoryHint.message: Questions about everything you've read and asked

askHistoryEmpty.message: Ask about everything you've read and asked with ContextFlow, across all your chats.

askHistoryEx1.message: What did I read this week?

askHistoryEx3.message: What have I learned about AI?

findPlaceholder.message: Describe the chat you're looking for…

findHint.message: Describe what you remember, in any words, and press Enter: “the article about sleep and coffee from last week”.

upsellFindTitle.message: Find any chat by what you remember

upsellFindText.message: Describe a chat in your own words — “that article about sleep and coffee from last week” — and AI finds it, even without the exact words.

upsellHistoryText.message: Questions across all your chats: “What have I read about saving for retirement?”, “Summarize my notes from this month”.

upsellMore.message: Plus videos and PDFs on the page, and up to 375 answers a week, deeper and more detailed, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

qiButton.message: Quick insert: copied text, templates, ContextFlow's answer

qiCopiedOff.message: Copied is off. Turn it on below.

qiCopiedEmpty.message: Copy text on any page in Safari, and it shows up here.

qiTemplatesEmpty.message: No templates yet. Tap + or select a reply you send often and tap Template.

qiTemplatesIntro.message: Save the replies you write again and again. ContextFlow marks what changes, like a name or a date, and can fill it in from the page.

qiPrivacy.message: Copied text stays on this {0} and is erased after 24 hours.

qiTip.message: New: tap to insert what you copied in other tabs, a template or ContextFlow's answer.

qiPasteManually.message: Copied. Paste it into the field yourself.

qiFillHint.message: Type in the blanks, pick from Copied, or let ContextFlow fill them from the page.

qiFillDone.message: Highlighted: taken from the page. Check before sending.

qiFillPartly.message: Highlighted: taken from the page. An empty blank wasn't found: fill it in yourself.

qiFillLimit.message: That's all free fills for today. With Pro there's no limit, and the blanks can still be filled in by hand.

qiFillConsent.message: To fill the blanks, ContextFlow sends this page's text and the template to Anthropic's Claude. Nothing is stored.

qiAdaptLabel.message: Fit the template to this page

qiTemplateText.message: Text. Put blanks in braces, like {Name}.

qiMarkedHint.message: The blanks are marked. Tap one to make it plain text again.

qiMarkedNone.message: Nothing here looks like it changes. Select a word and tap Blank to add one.

qiMarkFailed.message: Couldn't mark blanks now. It's saved as plain text, and blanks can be added by hand.

qiMarkConsent.message: To mark the blanks, ContextFlow sends this text to Anthropic's Claude. Nothing is stored.

qiBlankHint.message: Blanks are filled in when the template is inserted.

qiKeywords.message: Words to find it by, separated by commas

qiSetCopiedHint.message: The last 5 pieces of text copied on pages. They stay on this device and are erased after 24 hours. Nothing from password or card fields, or in Private Browsing.

qiSetSignHint.message: Type {0} and a few words of a template in any field.

qiSetShortcut.message: On a Mac or an iPad with a keyboard, ⌃⇧V opens the list.

hintChatsBody.message: Search by words or #tag. Tag chats and answers with 🏷 and turn on Folders to group them. In Pro, ✦ finds a chat from a description, and “Ask your chats” answers from all of them.

hintVideoBody.message: Answers use its transcript and point to moments like [4:15]. Without captions, they use the title and description, and say so.

hintPdfBody.message: The PDFs shown or linked on this page go with your question; answers say which page they're on.

proSkipVideo.message: The video on this page was skipped — Pro reads videos

proSkipPdf.message: PDFs on this page were skipped — Pro reads them

proSkipBoth.message: Video and PDF on this page were skipped — Pro reads them

emptyVideoFree.message: This page has a video. Pro answers use its transcript; free answers use what the page shows (title, description).

emptyPdfFree.message: This page has a PDF. Pro answers read it; free answers use the page's text.

hintVideoBodyFree.message: With Pro, answers use its transcript and point to moments like [4:15]. Free answers use the title and description.

hintPdfBodyFree.message: Pro reads the PDFs shown or linked on this page and says which page an answer comes from. Free answers use the page's text.

renewalBody.message: Auto-renewal is off. What was missing?

renewalFeatures.message: A feature I need is missing

renewalThanks.message: Thanks — that helps us improve ContextFlow.

byokLimitTitle.message: Today's answers through ContextFlow are used up

byokLimitNoKey.message: Your own key isn't added yet, so answers go through ContextFlow: {0} a day. Add your key in Settings, or move to Pro: up to {1} answers a week, no key needed.

byokLimitGoogle.message: On the Own key plan, Google answers go through ContextFlow: {0} a day. Pro gives you up to {1} answers a week.

byokSearch.message: On the Own key plan, Google search is {0} a day. Pro gives you {1} a week.

byokProOnly.message: Not part of the Own key plan.

byokOfferBody.message: Pro answers without your key: up to {0} a week, {1} Google searches a week, “Ask your chats” and AI search. The App Store shows the price and how long it lasts before you pay. Pro starts at once, and the unused part of your current plan is refunded.

orgSplitA11y.message: Move these messages to a new chat, “{0}”

orgFirstWin.message: Done. From now on ContextFlow will suggest on its own.

orgConsentText.message: ContextFlow will suggest a fitting chat and one of your tags under new answers and notes. For this, the text of your messages goes to our server and to OpenAI and Anthropic. We don't keep it. OpenAI and Anthropic don't use it for training.

orgMessText.message: In Pro, ContextFlow suggests what goes where and puts on tags the way you do.

orgTagsTitle.message: ContextFlow can tag the way you do

orgTagsText.message: In Pro it suggests one of your tags under new answers and notes, from where you put it yourself.

setOrganizeHint.message: A fitting chat and your tag under new answers and notes. The text of your messages goes to our server and to OpenAI and Anthropic. We don't keep it; they don't use it for training.

setOrganizePro.message: Pro: ContextFlow suggests a fitting chat and your tag under new answers and notes.

upsellOrganizeText.message: Suggests the right chat for what you just asked, and your own tag for it.
